function: Unsupervised-learned precoder for secure ISAC: MLPs map uplink pilots and echoes directly to the BS precoder, minimizing the maximum eavesdropper SINR under communication and sensing constraints (p. 1, 3).
system: Downlink ISAC, BS with 16-antenna half-wavelength ULA, 4 single-antenna users, 6 targets, one eavesdropper; no RIS; frequency band not stated (p. 2, 4).
method: Three-MLP network with power-normalization layer, unsupervised training with a loss derived from first-order (KKT) optimality conditions (p. 3-4).
data_channel: Own simulator: Rayleigh communication channel, path loss 30+36log10(d) dB; Ricean radar channel, path loss 30+22log10(d) dB; 100 channel realizations for training; no dataset (p. 4).
test_conditions: Trained and tested with unchanged pilot and echo statistics; tests sweep QoS thresholds, radar constraints, number of users K; retraining not described (p. 4-5).
baselines: SDP-based precoding with perfect CSI and with estimated CSI (Bartlett plus least squares); no learned baseline compared (p. 4).
metrics: SINR of the eavesdropper and of legitimate users versus QoS thresholds, radar performance constraints, and number of users (Figs. 3-5) (p. 4-5).
complexity: Big-O order of the network's inference, O(2(K+T)(2M*bl+sum bl*bl-1+bl*d)), against O(K^3.5 T^3.5 log(1/iota)) for SDP; no runtime measured (p. 4).
openness: none; no code or data link in the letter (p. 1-5).
q1_support: p. 4: "We model the communication channel using a Rayleigh distribution"; the radar channel is Ricean (p. 4). Custom simulator; no 3GPP, COST 2100, DeepMIMO or measured data.
q2_support: p. 4: "where both pilot and echo statistics remain unchanged"; Fig. 5 (p. 5) varies K, but the paper never states that a model trained at K = 4 is tested at another K or in another scenario.
q3_support: p. 4: "We compare our proposed deep learning-based solution with the SDP-based solution." Only a non-learned baseline; no earlier learned method ([11], [12], [13]) is compared.
q4_support: p. 4: "A common method for describing the complexity of an algorithm is the Big-O notation"; Section III-C gives O(2(K+T)(2M bl + ...)) for the network and O(K^3.5 T^3.5 log(1/iota)) for SDP.
q5_support: p. 4: "A total of 100 independent channel realizations were utilized for training"; channels come from the authors' own simulator and no code, data link or DOI appears in the letter.
notes: Included as ISAC (area 5): learned precoding under sensing and communication constraints; physical-layer security is the objective, not an excluded function. Joint implicit channel estimation and precoding from pilots and echoes (p. 2-3); main metric is SINR, so the function is beamforming. Fig. 5 (p. 5) sweeps K, yet the F-MLP input and output sizes depend on K and T (p. 3) and the paper never says the network is reused without retraining. The scheme is adapted from [13] (EUSIPCO 2023, p. 3-4), an earlier learned ISAC precoder that is not compared in the simulations (p. 4). RIS appears only in references [5], [6], [14].
